newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed sheds Martin Marietta Materials.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed sheds Martin Marietta Materials.

text.p: Martin Marietta Materials Inc said on Friday Lockheed Martin Corp has announced a final proration factor of 17.97 percent for the exchange offer for Lockheed Martin shareholders to exchange shares for Martin Marietta Materials shares.
In the oversubscribed offer, 42.88 million Lockheed Martin shares were offered in the exchange, Martin Marietta Materials said.
Lockheed Martin accepted 7,913,136 of its shares in exchange for 37,350,000 shares of Martin Marietta Materials that it had owned, Martin Marietta Materials said.
The exchange offer, which was oversubscribed, expired at midnight last Friday, Martin Marietta Materials said.

As a result of this transaction, Lockheed Martin has no remaining ownership interest in Martin Marietta Materials and has reduced its common shares outstanding by 7,913,136, or approximately 4 percent, to 192,542,724 shares, Martin Marietta Materials.
Martin Marietta Materials has 46,079,300 shares outstanding, the company said.
